raw_physical_line_reading: I give two specimens of Ahīrwāṭī. One is in the Dēvanāgarī character, and is a ver-
sion of the Parable of the Prodigal Son from Gurgaon. The other, written in the Persian
character, is in the mixed dialect of Jhajjar of Rohtak.
normalized_context_summary: Grierson introduces two specimens: the Gurgaon Prodigal Son in Devanagari and a mixed Jhajjar/Rohtak specimen in Persian script.
